$comment: Banking Correspondent (BC) / kiosk directory.
THIS FILE IS INTENTIONALLY EMPTY.
FinLeaf does not ship a list of banking agents. Inventing plausible agent
names, shop names and phone numbers would be actively harmful: a user
looking up 'nearby agent' would find a real person's number and call them,
and the number would have nothing to do with any banking service. It would
also be fabricated personal data about identifiable individuals.
The directory is operator-supplied data. In a real deployment the BC
network operator loads their own agent records, because only they know who
is actually authorised to accept deposits and withdrawals.
HOW TO POPULATE IT
1. Admin API:  POST /api/admin/agents  (see src/app/api/admin/agents)
2. Or edit this file and run:  npm run db:seed
REQUIRED FIELDS PER AGENT
name       - the agent's name, as the operator records it
shopName   - the kiosk / shop name shown to users
village    - village or locality, used for the text search fallback
phone      - the operator's own contact number for this agent, in E.164
latitude   - decimal degrees
longitude  - decimal degrees
openHours  - free text, e.g. 'Mon-Sat 09:00-18:00'
Only publish an agent once the operator has confirmed the record. Consent
to being listed with a phone number is the operator's to give, not ours.
